<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Get indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
missingness_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = int(df[col].isna().sum())
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = 1 if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 0
    missingness_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_count,
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_df = pd.DataFrame(missingness_data)
missingness_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Get the list of kept indicators
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missingness_df[missingness_df['indicator'] == col]['kept'].values[0] == 1]

# Create selected matrix
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL)
</solution_file>
